title: Tidepool Treatment Times are Incorrect
body: Notice in the attached screenshots that the treatments given in the evening of April 3rd show up in the morning of April 4th. If this is difficult to reproduce, it may have to do with timezone shifting or loading settings from a different phone. On March 21st I flew from Cambodia to Canada. A week later I changed phones and loaded the settings from the old phone to the new via QR code. Maybe these are irrelevant details, but maybe not.
